messages:
marcus-sales: Heads-up: Oxbow Systems wants a concise perf POC next Tue. Ask: sustain 250 qps for a 800-token average completion with p95 < 180ms and p99 < 320ms. Theyre evaluating Dedicated vs on-prem. Can we run this within a half-day window and provide a back-of-envelope committed cost? :mag:

 anya-eng: 250 qps for 800 tokens is doable with Dedicated sizing + prefix cache. Need the exact distribution (prompt vs completion tokens), streaming preference, and if they require mTLS. Also, are they expecting multiregion?

 leila-ml: I'd run Redwood-22B optimized runtime as primary and RedCloud-7B-quant as fallback. We'll measure p50/p95/p99 and token-efficiency. Suggest a canary + steady ramp: canary 30m at 50 qps, ramp 15m to 250, 45m steady, cool down. We can inject 15% complex prompts (multi-paragraph) to hit long-tail.

 sam-ops: Ops plan: reserve a 6h slot next Tue 08:00-14:00 UTC to include priming and post-run cleanup. Proposed infra: 3x H100-80GB workers, dynamic batching, 3 workers behind LB with autoscale headroom. Priming: 10m with 5k prefixes. We'll generate an infra ticket and reserve a Dedicated pool.

 compliance-bot: Reminder: for Dedicated we support BYOK and region pinning; SCIM + SAML available in Private. Standard POC export logs retained for 30 days unless otherwise requested. For 90+ days, need contract amendment.

 marcus-sales: Oxbow asked specifically about audit export and PCI/SOC2 controls in the POC. Can we provide 90-day retention for the run? They also want an IP allowlist for the test harness.

 sam-ops: For the short POC we can set 90-day retention on audit logs. IP allowlist fine  send the CIDR ranges. We'll enable BYOK hooks if requested.

 anya-eng: Routing policy: failover to 7B quant at 95th if p95 breaches 220ms, and to synchronous short-response mode (reduce max tokens) if p99 > 350ms. Also enable streaming where possible to improve perceived latency.

 leila-ml: Test mix: 70% short (50-200 tokens), 20% medium (300-700), 10% heavy (1k-1.5k). We'll precompute expected token counts and attach eval checks for hallucination rate.

 Load generator (k6-like) snippet:

 ```json
 {
   "vus": 300,
   "duration": "75m",
   "stages": [
     {"duration": "10m", "target": 20},
     {"duration": "15m", "target": 250},
     {"duration": "45m", "target": 250},
     {"duration": "5m", "target": 0}
   ],
   "mix": {"short": 0.7, "medium": 0.2, "heavy": 0.1}
 }
 ```

 sam-ops: Priming curl (admin API):

 ```bash
 curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.example/v1/cache/prime \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PRIME_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/jsonl" \
  --data-binary @prefixes_5k.jsonl
 ```

 anya-eng: Quick cost heuristic: convert to GPU-hours. Estimate: with 3x H100s at near-sustained load, ~3 GPU-hours for 1 hour steady plus prep. For a monthly committed bundle to support sustained 250 qps in production, ballpark is 3-6 H100-equivalent GPUs reserved (monthly). I'll draft a more precise GPU-hour -> price note tomorrow. Don't promise hosted pricing; hosted token costs for long-run aren't competitive here.

 leila-ml: Observability plan: capture per-request token_count, model variant, kv_hit, p50/p95/p99, and hallucination signal. We'll run an automated eval against 200 sample prompts at start/mid/end to detect regressions.

 marcus-sales: Action items: (1) I'll collect Oxbow IPs + SSO contact (today). (2) Sam, please create infra ticket and reserve pool (by EOD). (3) Anya/Leila, finalize routing fallback and priming artifact list by tomorrow EOD. (4) I'll provide a preliminary committed quote range once you post GPU-hour estimate.

 sam-ops: Created ticket INF-4620, reserved draft pool, tagged @anya-eng @leila-ml. Calendar invite sent to Oxbow for Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC (they asked for local AM).

 anya-eng: I'll post a sizing doc with GPU-hour calc and expected latency curves in #eng-runtime by tomorrow.

 compliance-bot: Note: please red-team dataflow if PII is included. If PII, we need encryption-at-rest and KMS key usage for the Dedicated control plane.

 marcus-sales: thanks all  I'll update Oxbow and drop the IP list here once I have it. :rocket:
